description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Definition' that serves as a superclass for various datatype definition objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties for setup status and type, and declares abstract and concrete setup methods to initialize the definition objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Definition
classes.description: Abstract superclass for datatype definition objects, providing setup mechanisms and properties for tracking setup state and type.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Abstract method to set up the definition object with the given configuration. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the definition object by calling doSetup if it has not been set up yet. Sets the setup flag to true.
